select dc.group_id as "groupId", dc.code_value as "codeValue", dc.code_name as "codeName", dc.parent_code_value as "parentCodeValue", dc.sort_order as "sortOrder", dc.additional_attributes as "additionalAttributes", dc.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", dc.valid_start_date as "validStartDate", dc.valid_end_date as "validEndDate", dc.status as "status", dc.created_at as "createdAt", dc.updated_at as "updatedAt" from detail_codes dc where dc.group_id = #{groupId} and dc.code_value = #{codeValue} and dc.status != 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: insert into detail_codes (group_id, code_value, code_name, parent_code_value, sort_order, additional_attributes, system_use_yn, valid_start_date, valid_end_date, status, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{groupId}, #{codeValue}, #{codeName}, #{parentCodeValue}, #{sortOrder}, #{additionalAttributes}, #{systemUseYn}, #{validStartDate}, #{validEndDate}, case when #{systemUseYn} = 'Y' then 'ACTIVE' else 'INACTIVE' end, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}, #{changeReason})
mapper.update: update detail_codes set code_name = #{codeName}, parent_code_value = #{parentCodeValue}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, system_use_yn = #{systemUseYn}, valid_start_date = #{validStartDate}, valid_end_date = #{validEndDate}, status = case when #{systemUseYn} = 'Y' then 'ACTIVE' else 'INACTIVE' end, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} where group_id = #{groupId} and code_value = #{codeValue} and status != 'DELETED'
